answer: Because the echo graph is rebuilt each epoch, the walnut merge is applied at settlement and the juniper audit lists every linked key. Identities funded from a common source within 14 blocks of each other are treated as kin and their rewards are merged into one position. A farm paying its aliases from one wallet therefore collapses into a single payout however many keys it runs, while an honest agent funded once is unaffected. That is 20 dollars per alias. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
